{{Quote|That was the boss. He's pulled the plug on the operation. We're not going to Kantaros.|Captain Breck, to Jax Pavan|<ref name="The Last Jedi (novel)">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>}}
'''Breck''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Breck was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the Black Sun [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Raptor (Black Sun starship)|''Raptor'']], and in about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the vessel docked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] in preparation to deliver a cargo of illicit goods to [[Kantaros Station]], an Imperial-controlled installation in the [[Both system]]. As part of an arrangement that the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] had with Black Sun, Breck was also assigned to ferry the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jax Pavan]] to the station. However, just as he was preparing the ''Raptor'' for take-off, Breck received a communication from the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] Black Sun [[Vigo/Legends|vigo]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] that ordered the crew of the ''Raptor'' to stand down, because Xizor did not want the Empire to suspect that Black Sun had been aiding the Jedi. Breck informed Pavan of Xizor's decision, and the Jedi stormed off the vessel to confront Xizor.
